newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: ABR SAYS PT ANEKA PURCHASE DEAL DELAYED.
newsitem.headline: ABR SAYS PT ANEKA PURCHASE DEAL DELAYED.

text.p: ABR Holdings Ltd said on Wednesday it had postponed plans to take a controlling stake in Indonesian food firm PT Aneka Food Tatarasa Industri (Aneka).
ABR said in a statement it had deferred the US$1.6 million deal after learning of factors which "confirmed the company's preliminary view that Aneka has failed to perform up to expectations".
ABR said Aneka sales had been hit by changes in its distribution network, that raw material prices had eroded margins and a significant quantity of its stock was unsaleable.
ABR said in November 1996 it planned to by 51 percent of Aneka from PT Panjang Sejahtera Perskasa.
While ABR had been assured that action had been taken to rectify the situation, it said the deal had been sidelined "for the sake of prudence and to protect shareholders' interests".
A final decision on the purchase is expected to made by early 1998.
ABR said the delay would not impact earnings or net asset values in the current financial year.
